searchText: Here is some analysis for memory copying in the EVM which presents an estimated pricing model for a proposed `MCOPY` opcode and data for frequency and size-distribution of bulk copying done in mainnet contracts: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/evm-mcopy-analysis
